Author: Valentina Vieri
Name: VieriNexus
Punchline: Nexus-owned route authoring, preview, and guarded playback.
Description: The unified, modular Vieri suite in active development. Routes & Navigation now provides a Nexus-owned working library, manual route authoring, persistent world preview, guarded same-zone travel/playback, verified Stop, manual takeover, reload recovery, and cross-plugin path yielding. VieriNavPlotter must be unloaded manually before Nexus movement can be approved.
